trust_decision.summary: Whether a stored cookie may be sent to a host that is only a subdomain spelling-variant of its Domain attribute: decided in GuzzleHttp\Cookie\SetCookie::matchesDomain(), which must keep a noncanonical cookie domain (percent-escaped, or inet_aton numeric in decimal/octal/hex) exact-match-only instead of suffix-matching it.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'noncanonical cookie domain keeps subdomain scope'; this is the branch in matchesDomain() that decides a cookie domain is exact-match-only, and it already enumerates IP literals, bracketed IPv6, trailing dots and an all-digit rightmost label - exactly the spot an engineer would extend first.

fix_sites.entry_point: GuzzleHttp\Cookie\SetCookie::matchesDomain() - reached from CookieJar::withCookieHeader() (CookieJar.php:313) and CookieJar::extractCookies() (CookieJar.php:264), and so from any Client request using a cookie jar (Middleware::cookies, Middleware.php:36,41)
same as above - private isIpAddressOrNumericHost() called at SetCookie.php:517; the fix makes it delegate to the transport's inet_aton grammar
consumed as GuzzleHttp\Handler\HostValidator::isNumericIpv4Host() from src/Cookie/SetCookie.php via fix.diff:1651; the same helper is also used by HostValidator::assertRequestHost() at fix.diff:1817
fix_sites.module_kind: new @internal static helper in the Handler (transport) package - file absent at the pinned commit (fix.diff:1681-1884)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: fix.diff:1832 - GuzzleHttp\Handler\HostValidator::isNumericIpv4Host(), a public static primitive in the transport package that the Cookie package now depends on (fix.diff:1651)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: HostValidator is transport-side host validation shipped for a different advisory in the same commit, so the cookie report can be satisfied entirely inside GuzzleHttp\Cookie and the handler-side helper looks like someone else's file (a private duplicate is an easy substitute).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A name whose labels merely resemble numbers keeps subdomain scope in Guzzle 7: cookie domain 'svc.0xdeadbeef' must still match 'a.svc.0xdeadbeef' and '0xname' must still match 'sub.0xname', while only a 1-4-part inet_aton-shaped domain is exact-only; and the percent rule applies to the cookie domain only - a percent-bearing request host ('%65vil.example.com') must still suffix-match cookie domain 'example.com'. An over-broad 'any hex-looking label or any % is opaque' fix breaks all three.
O5_coupled_behaviour.where: src/Cookie/SetCookie.php:527 (subdomain suffix regex) and src/Cookie/SetCookie.php:548-552 (rightmost-label rule); pinned as negative controls at fix.diff:2050-2051

O6_input_shapes: percent-escaped cookie domain, part or whole ('127.0.0.%31', '192.168.0.%31', '%30x7f000001')
short and integer inet_aton forms ('127.1', '2130706433', '0.') and one-to-four parts generally
leading-dot and multiple-trailing-dot spellings ('.127.0.0.%31', '127.0.0.1..' via rtrim)

O7_producer.where: src/Cookie/CookieJar.php:240-274 (extractCookies builds the SetCookie from the Set-Cookie header, rewrites a dot-terminated Domain to the request host and sets HostOnly) and src/Cookie/SetCookie.php:42-92 (fromString)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second canonicalizer in the same class (e.g. isIpLiteral()/canonicalDomain()) used by validate() to reject noncanonical domains at storage time
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This file already grows canonicalization one shape at a time (brackets, trailing dot, rightmost numeric label), so a maintainer adding the next shape here is exactly how the previous fixes landed.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: canonicalize the Set-Cookie Domain attribute in extractCookies before the host-only derivation
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: That branch already rewrites the Domain (dot-terminated domains become the origin host and HostOnly=true), so it is the natural place to normalize a percent-escaped or IDN domain.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: re-derive HostOnly/Domain on load from the JSON file instead of trusting the stored marker
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The loader is the designated trust boundary for reloaded cookie state (it already hard-fails when HostOnly is absent or not a bool), so a scope check belongs there in a later change.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: canonicalize the domain inside the public setDomain() mutator
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: setDomain() is the documented mutation point and is called from the constructor, fromString() and extractCookies(), so a fix placed there would cover constructed cookies as well as parsed ones.

O9_family: cookie-domain scope / origin validation - CWE-346 origin validation error with CWE-180 (validate before canonicalizing)
